description: Describe an Emerald document (a .emd file): whether this plugin will serve it, the formats it declares with how many rows each holds, and — when it keeps the ledger — its accounts, transactions, categories and reporting currency. Call it when a tool refuses a document — every tool refuses one whose schema does not match, and this is the one that says so in a sentence the user can act on. Reads the file; never modifies it.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
